versions.subject: fix very bad cut and paste
versions.detection:
selection_tools:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'sqlcmd '
        - 'sqlcmd.exe'
selection_svr:
    CommandLine|contains: ' -S localhost '
selection_query:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'sys.sysprocesses'
        - 'master.dbo.sysdatabases'
        - 'BACKUP DATABASE'
condition: all of them
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*sqlcmd *", "*sqlcmd.exe*") CommandLine="* -S localhost *" CommandLine IN ("*sys.sysprocesses*", "*master.dbo.sysdatabases*", "*BACKUP DATABASE*")
